name: Exercise Catalogue Import
objective: Import 20 structured exercises from the hunched-shoulders catalogue through a reusable parser and preserve local library compatibility.
exit_criteria: The import standard documents the ordered fields, array delimiters, record boundaries, type mapping, and report-level exclusions.
The pure parser accepts the documented text format, ignores introduction/monitoring/references, and rejects incomplete exercise records.
The app library contains all 20 source exercises exactly once with stable ids and structured arrays for muscles, steps, errors, tags, and sources.
Source exercise categories remain available while app exercise types are valid Strength or Stretch values.
Existing starter exercises and local-storage reads/writes remain compatible.
Parser, conversion, count, storage regression, full test, lint, and build checks pass.
